title: North America Lost 2.9 Billion Birds—Mostly Common Ones
hook: Familiar backyard birds disappeared while they still looked abundant.
closing: Common birds can vanish quietly, so familiar flocks still need protection.
question: Which birds have vanished near you?

segments.say: North America lost 2.9 billion breeding birds. The collapse extends far beyond a few rare species.
Grassland birds declined 53 percent. Some habitats are losing birds much faster than others.
Common bird families account for 90 percent of the total loss. Familiarity did not protect their populations.
